articles.title: Daring Five-Minute Art Heist in France!
articles.summary: Thieves used an electric saw to steal two Renoir paintings from a museum in France—in just five minutes! They dropped two others while running from police. The paintings are worth millions!

articles.title: What If America Was Called 'Alleghania'?
articles.summary: Before settling on the United States of America, the founders considered names like the United Colonies and even Alleghania! Learn how the country got its name—and why the 'U' in 'United' was once lowercase.

articles.title: Elton John Plays Rare Song 'Skyline Pigeon' in Brazil!
articles.summary: Elton John surprised fans at Rock in Rio by playing 'Skyline Pigeon'—a song from 1969 he rarely performs! He told the crowd it was the first good song he wrote with Bernie Taupin.
